nodes.name: Claim Comment
nodes.notes: Webhook idempotency (ADR-029, migration 018_webhook_dedup, 2026-06-11). Atomic claim on the triggering comment id: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; the unique PK serialises the two near-simultaneous deliveries ClickUp sends for one @-mention (~45ms apart) so exactly one wins. Returns is_first (also true when comment id is empty -> never blocks). onError:continueRegularOutput + retry -> a DB blip fails OPEN (is_first undefined downstream).

parameters.query:
with ins as (
  insert into agent_webhook_dedup (triggering_comment_id)
  values ($1)
  on conflict (triggering_comment_id) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (exists (select 1 from ins) or coalesce($1, '') = '') as is_first;

nodes.name: Not Duplicate?
nodes.notes: is_first !== false -> proceed (true, incl. DB-error fail-open where is_first is undefined); is_first === false -> duplicate delivery, dead-end (drop). Complements the Recent Runs / Under Limit? loop-breaker: THIS kills exact-comment duplicates (at-least-once delivery), THAT caps agent->agent storms.

nodes.name: Read Queue Flag
nodes.notes: ADR-056 Block 3: read config.queue_enabled to choose enqueue vs synchronous fallback. onError:continueRegularOutput + retry -> a DB blip passes the input item through with no `value` field, so Queue Enabled? evaluates false and the run falls back to the synchronous Run Agent Spine (fail-safe to the known-good path).

parameters.query: select value from config where key = 'queue.enabled' limit 1;

nodes.name: Fetch Task Impact
nodes.notes: ADR-056 Block 3: fetch the task so Build Enqueue Job can read the [AI] Wpływ custom field for queue priority. onError:continueRegularOutput + retry -> a ClickUp blip degrades to the Średni default (Build Job try/catch), never a throw.

nodes.name: Build Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: ADR-056 Block 3: assemble the /enqueue job. dedup_comment_id = the OWN comment id (distinct per @-mention -> distinct job, so follow-ups are not collapsed); payload.triggering_comment_id = reply_to_comment_id (thread root) for the spine's reply, matching the sync mapping.

nodes.name: Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: ADR-056 Block 3: POST the job to the queue-consumer over the internal Docker network. onError:continueErrorOutput -> a non-200 or unreachable consumer routes to output 1, which falls back to the synchronous Run Agent Spine AND fires a WARN (ADR-056 §9 failover; never silently drop the mention).
